content: Inline platform enum values in Zod schemas instead of importing from other packages to avoid Zod v4 cross-package schema recognition errors at runtime.

name: readable-stream-redis-cleanup
description: Use ReadableStream with a cancel callback to manage Redis pub/sub lifecycle in Next.js App Router SSE endpoints. The cancel handler unsubscribes from the Redis channel and disconnects the subscriber when the client drops.

name: eventsource-custom-event-listeners
description: In EventSource, custom event types like event: platform_update require addEventListener(platform_update, handler) rather than onmessage. The hook should listen for each specific event type and update corresponding React state slices.

name: worker-wallet-balance-events
description: After every credit mutation (capture or release), the worker should read the current wallet balance and publish a credits_update event. This ensures the frontend always sees the latest available and reserved credit values without polling.

Opening an SSE Redis pub/sub connection with ioredis and immediately calling SUBSCRIBE can race with ioredis ready-check commands, producing 'Connection in subscriber mode, only subscriber commands may be used'.
resolution: Create the subscriber with lazyConnect and wait for the dedicated Redis client to reach ready before subscribing.
